name: flaggems_cslt_sparse_mm
description: CUTLASS/cuSPARSELt 2:4 structured sparse matrix multiplication: computes C = A_sparse @ B where compressed_A is the CUTLASS-compressed (torch._cslt_compress) form of a dense (M, K) matrix and dense_B is (K, N), yielding (M, N). Optional bias (M,) add and scalar alpha scale epilogue; transpose_result=True returns (N, M). CUDA-only; compressed_A is created via gen_inputs.
